<?php
/**
 * Payment Processing Service - Kubernetes Deployment
 * Handles idempotent payment requests with distributed locking
 * 
 * Environment: PHP 8.2, Redis cluster, PostgreSQL
 * Deployment: Kubernetes StatefulSet with 3 replicas
 */

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Payment;
use App\Models\Transaction;
use App\Repositories\PaymentRepository;
use App\Cache\DistributedLock;
use App\Events\PaymentProcessed;

class PaymentProcessor
{
    private DistributedLock $lock;
    private PaymentRepository $repository;
    private string $podIdentifier;
    private int $lockTtlMs;

    public function __construct(
        DistributedLock $lock,
        PaymentRepository $repository
    ) {
        $this->lock = $lock;
        $this->repository = $repository;
        $this->podIdentifier = getenv('HOSTNAME') ?: gethostname();
        $this->lockTtlMs = (int)(getenv('LOCK_TTL_MS') ?: 5000);
    }

    /**
     * Process a payment with idempotency guarantees.
     * Uses distributed locking to prevent double-processing.
     */
    public function processPayment(string $idempotencyKey, array $paymentData): Transaction
    {
        // Check for existing completed transaction (idempotency)
        $existing = $this->repository->findByIdempotencyKey($idempotencyKey);
        if ($existing && $existing->isCompleted()) {
            return $existing;
        }

        // Acquire distributed lock with pod-specific token
        $lockKey = $this->buildLockKey($idempotencyKey);
        $lockToken = $this->generateLockToken();

        if (!$this->lock->acquire($lockKey, $lockToken, $this->lockTtlMs)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Payment is being processed by another instance');
        }

        try {
            // Re-check after acquiring lock (double-check pattern)
            $existing = $this->repository->findByIdempotencyKey($idempotencyKey);
            if ($existing && $existing->isCompleted()) {
                return $existing;
            }

            // Validate payment amount and create pending record
            $payment = $this->createPendingPayment($idempotencyKey, $paymentData);

            // Execute the actual charge
            $transaction = $this->executeCharge($payment);

            // Mark as completed
            $this->repository->markCompleted($transaction);

            event(new PaymentProcessed($transaction));

            return $transaction;
        } finally {
            $this->releaseLock($lockKey, $lockToken);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Builds the lock key for a given idempotency key.
     * Includes namespace prefix for multi-tenant isolation.
     */
    private function buildLockKey(string $idempotencyKey): string
    {
        $tenantId = app('tenant')->getId();
        return "payment_lock:{$tenantId}:{$idempotencyKey}";
    }

    /**
     * Generate a unique lock token combining pod identity and randomness.
     */
    private function generateLockToken(): string
    {
        return $this->podIdentifier . ':' . bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
    }

    /**
     * Release the lock only if we still own it (compare-and-delete).
     * Uses Lua script for atomicity in Redis.
     */
    private function releaseLock(string $lockKey, string $lockToken): void
    {
        $this->lock->releaseIfOwned($lockKey, $lockToken);
    }

    private function createPendingPayment(string $idempotencyKey, array $paymentData): Payment
    {
        $amount = $this->validateAmount($paymentData['amount'] ?? 0);
        $currency = $this->validateCurrency($paymentData['currency'] ?? 'USD');

        return $this->repository->createPending([
            'idempotency_key' => $idempotencyKey,
            'amount' => $amount,
            'currency' => $currency,
            'customer_id' => $paymentData['customer_id'],
            'pod_id' => $this->podIdentifier,
        ]);
    }

    private function validateAmount($amount): int
    {
        $amount = (int)$amount;
        if ($amount <= 0 || $amount > 99999999) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid payment amount');
        }
        return $amount;
    }

    private function validateCurrency(string $currency): string
    {
        $allowed = ['USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY'];
        if (!in_array($currency, $allowed, true)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Unsupported currency');
        }
        return $currency;
    }

    private function executeCharge(Payment $payment): Transaction
    {
        // Gateway interaction with retry logic
        return $this->repository->chargePayment($payment);
    }
}

/**
 * Distributed Lock implementation using Redis
 */
class RedisDistributedLock implements DistributedLock
{
    private $redis;

    public function __construct($redis)
    {
        $this->redis = $redis;
    }

    public function acquire(string $key, string $token, int $ttlMs): bool
    {
        // SET key token NX PX ttlMs
        $result = $this->redis->set($key, $token, ['NX', 'PX' => $ttlMs]);
        return $result === true;
    }

    /**
     * Release lock using Lua for atomicity.
     * Critical: validates ownership before deletion.
     */
    public function releaseIfOwned(string $key, string $token): bool
    {
        // Lua script: check-and-delete atomically
        $script = <<<'LUA'
            if redis.call('get', KEYS[1]) == ARGV[1] then
                return redis.call('del', KEYS[1])
            else
                return 0
            end
LUA;
        return (bool)$this->redis->eval($script, [$key], [$token]);
    }
}

/**
 * Kubernetes health check endpoint for the payment service.
 * Verifies Redis connectivity and lock service availability.
 */
class HealthCheckController
{
    private RedisDistributedLock $lock;

    public function __construct(RedisDistributedLock $lock)
    {
        $this->lock = $lock;
    }

    public function readiness(): array
    {
        $testKey = 'health:lock:' . getenv('HOSTNAME');
        $testToken = bin2hex(random_bytes(8));

        // Verify lock service is operational
        $acquired = $this->lock->acquire($testKey, $testToken, 1000);
        if ($acquired) {
            $this->lock->releaseIfOwned($testKey, $testToken);
        }

        return ['status' => $acquired ? 'ready' : 'degraded'];
    }
}
